recentIncidents.title: Elevated errors on claude.ai, the Claude API, and Claude Code

updates.body: We are investigating reports of degraded performance affecting claude.ai, the Claude API, and Claude Code. We will provide an update as soon as possible.
We are investigating reports of degraded performance affecting claude.ai, the Claude API, Claude Code, and connectors (including Claude Docs and Claude Sheets).

We are investigating reports of degraded performance affecting a variety of surfaces including claude.ai, the Claude API, Claude Code, connectors (including Claude Docs and Claude Sheets), Claude Security and Claude Managed Agents.

We're seeing recovery on claude.ai and the Claude API, though errors may return while we continue working on this. Connectors, including Docs and Sheets, remain degraded, as do Claude in Meetings, Claude Managed Agents, Claude Security and connector use in Claude Code. Mobile apps are affected in the same way as claude.ai. We'll share another update soon.

Errors on claude.ai, including the mobile apps, the Claude API and Claude Code have returned to normal levels, and we are continuing to monitor. Existing connectors, including Docs and Sheets, are working again, and Claude Managed Agents and Claude Meetings are recovering. Adding a new connector on claude.ai is temporarily unavailable. Scheduled tasks and routines can run more than two hours late and some runs have been skipped, and Claude Security scans, reviews and project setup remain delayed. We'll share another update soon.
The issue affecting multiple surfaces has been resolved.

recentIncidents.title: Claude for Microsoft 365 add-in missing for some users

updates.body: We are investigating an issue causing the Claude add-in to disappear from Excel, Word, and PowerPoint on Mac for users signed in to Microsoft Office with a personal Microsoft account. Work and school accounts do not appear affected, and Claude's other apps are unaffected. We will provide an update as soon as possible.

We are continuing to investigate an issue causing the Claude add-in to disappear from Excel, Word, and PowerPoint on Mac for users signed in to Microsoft Office with a personal Microsoft account. In the meantime, we recommend using the web versions of Excel, Word, and PowerPoint at office.com, where Claude remains available for many users. Work and school accounts do not appear affected. We will provide another update as soon as possible.

We have identified an issue with an upstream provider that is causing the Claude add-in to disappear from Excel, Word, and PowerPoint on Mac for users signed in to Microsoft Office with a personal Microsoft account. We are in contact with them. In the meantime, we recommend using the web versions of Excel, Word, and PowerPoint at office.com, where Claude remains available for many users. We will provide another update as soon as possible.

Our upstream provider has applied a mitigation for the issue that caused the Claude add-in to disappear from Excel, Word, and PowerPoint on Mac for users signed in to Microsoft Office with a personal Microsoft account, and we are monitoring for recovery. If Claude is still missing, try adding it again from Microsoft Marketplace, or use the web versions of Excel, Word, and PowerPoint at office.com, where Claude remains available for many users. We will provide another update as soon as possible.

recentIncidents.title: Claude Meetings auto-join limited on the Team plan

updates.body: We are investigating an issue preventing Claude from joining new calls in Claude Meetings (beta). Calls already in progress are not affected, and core functionality is not impacted. We will provide an update as soon as possible.
We are continuing to investigate an issue preventing Claude from joining new calls in Claude Meetings (beta).

We have temporarily paused Auto-join while we work on this. Adding Claude to a call by hand is also affected. Calls already in progress are not affected. We will provide another update as soon as possible.

Claude may still be unable to join some calls in Claude Meetings (beta), and Auto-join remains paused. Calls already in progress and other Claude features are not affected. We expect this to take some time to fully resolve and will post an update when the status changes.

Claude Meetings (beta) saw higher than expected demand today, and Claude was unable to join many calls. We have put mitigations in place and are continuing to monitor and improve join reliability.

Claude Meetings is now re-enabled for all Enterprise customers, though Claude may take a little longer than usual to join. Adding Claude to new calls and Auto-join remain paused for Team customers. We will share more updates as we expand capacity and begin restoring the feature for Team customers.

Claude Meetings (beta) is joining calls more reliably, and we are monitoring it. It remains enabled for all Enterprise customers. Team customers can again add Claude to new calls manually, and Auto-join is being restored gradually for Team customers.

Claude Meetings (beta) is joining calls normally. Enterprise and Team customers can add Claude to calls. Auto-join is available for all Enterprise customers and some Team customers. We'll continue rolling out auto-join to additional Team customers in the coming days.

updates.body: We are investigating elevated errors and slow responses affecting the Microsoft 365 connector. Requests to mail, SharePoint, Teams chat and calendar through the connector may fail, and new connections to the connector may not complete. We will provide an update as soon as possible.

We have identified an issue with an upstream provider affecting the Microsoft 365 connector. Mail, calendar and search tools are failing for most requests, and new connections to the connector may not complete. We are in contact with them and will provide an update as soon as possible.

We are continuing to work with our upstream provider on this issue. Mail, calendar and search tools in the Microsoft 365 connector are still failing for most requests. Claude for Outlook is also affected: mail and calendar actions may fail, and some users may not be able to open the add-in. We will provide another update within the hour.

We are continuing to work with our upstream provider, who is restarting affected servers. Mail, calendar and search tools in the Microsoft 365 connector are still failing for most requests, and Claude for Outlook remains affected. We will provide another update as soon as we have more information.

This issue is caused by a Microsoft 365 service incident, and mail, calendar and search tools in the Microsoft 365 connector are still failing for most requests. Claude for Outlook remains affected. You can follow Microsoft's progress at https://status.cloud.microsoft. We will update this post when service is restored.

We're seeing signs of recovery for the Microsoft 365 connector. Claude for Outlook is also recovering. Some SharePoint search requests are still returning errors.
